Renfrew is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 179 homes sold there: 89 houses, 15 condos, 10 townhomes and 64 duplexes. 89 houses sold in Renfrew with a median price of $1,620,000 (the middle half sold between $1,498,000 and $1,885,000), taking a median of 15 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 19% sold above list.
Renfrew home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

89 houses sold in Renfrew with a median price of $1,620,000 (the middle half sold between $1,498,000 and $1,885,000), taking a median of 15 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 19% sold above list. They had a median $745 per square foot, a median year built of 1964 and a median lot of 4,026 square feet. 64 duplexes sold in Renfrew with a median price of $1,350,000 (the middle half sold between $1,171,000 and $1,456,250), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $912 per square foot, a median year built of 2026 and a median strata fee of $343 a month.

items.t: "Renfrew VE" is an MLS sub-area name; the City-side name is the Renfrew-Collingwood local area, which the Province also lists as a community health service area.
The Rupert and Renfrew Station Area Plan is focused on the Rupert and Renfrew SkyTrain stations.

Council approved the Rupert and Renfrew Station Area Plan on July 8, 2025, a 30-year guide: towers up to 45 storeys near stations, villages up to six storeys, and multiplex areas that keep R1-1 zoning.
In January 2026 Council approved zoning updates for the villages: townhouses and low-rise apartments, generally to four storeys strata, six rental and eight below-market rental or social housing.
Named villages: Rupert and East 22nd, Renfrew and East 22nd, Renfrew and East 1st, with parts of Nanaimo and East Broadway and Nanaimo and East 1st.
R1-1 (in effect October 17, 2023) replaced the former RS zones and allows multiplexes of up to 6 strata or 8 rental units.
The Joyce-Collingwood Station Precinct Plan is a separate 30-year framework near that station, stepping heights down toward single-family areas.

blocks.text: Renfrew: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Renfrew Park Community Centre is at 2929 East 22nd Avenue and includes a fitness centre and pool.
The Park Board's plan memo names Renfrew Ravine, Still Creek, Rupert Park, Beaconsfield Park and Slocan Park.
Renfrew Community Elementary, 3315 East 22nd Avenue, K-7, is part of the Windermere Family of Schools; VSB states no catchment boundary and links a locator.
TransLink lists Renfrew and Rupert on the Millennium Line and Joyce-Collingwood on the Expo Line.

blocks.text: Renfrew: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: The plan includes nature-based flood management along Still Creek, with parts of the creek to be daylit.
A Groundwater Protection Area in the Building By-law restricts underground structures to protect Still Creek.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% of assessed value for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did homes in Renfrew sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Renfrew recorded 89 house sales at a median of $1,620,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Renfrew?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 15 days. At the median, sale prices were 97.4% of list, and 19% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Renfrew sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 89 houses that sold in Renfrew went for between $1,498,000 and $1,885,000, around a median of $1,620,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Renfrew sell above asking price?
faq.a: 19% of the 89 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.4% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Renfrew?
faq.a: The median year built was 1964 for the 89 houses sold in Renfrew.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Renfrew usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Renfrew had 5 bedrooms, from the 89 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
